controls.name: Owned Private Gateway and SFU Startup
controls.description: Verifies that the probe starts the real private LiveKit SFU and gateway containers via startGatewayFixture with credentials from .env.local; zero fallback to localhost/devkey.

controls.name: Service Resolution and Sweep Timer Isolation
controls.description: Ensures that CallLifecycleService is obtained via FG_CALL_LIFECYCLE token, its periodic timer is cleared, and any in-flight sweep is awaited before marking fixture ready.

controls.name: Canonical HTTP Call Creation and Admission
controls.description: Executes real HTTP call creation and user join via official endpoints to produce legitimate database records in call_groups, call_members, and call_admissions.

controls.name: Real LiveKit SDK Calls with Controlled Synthetic Delay
controls.description: Confirms that the native adapter calls real client listRooms and listParticipants with a 40ms synthetic delay, returning or rethrowing original results/errors with zero invented fallback.

controls.name: Real Database Contention Sampling
controls.description: Samples pg_stat_activity and pg_blocking_pids from the retained inspector client during concurrent reconciliation to observe genuine PostgreSQL wait events.

controls.name: Expected Bounded Native Read RED Assertion
controls.description: Asserts that actualListRoomsCalls <= 2 for a fixed burst of 4 concurrent triggers. On current un-coalesced source, this fails with exit code 1 because 4 redundant passes execute sequentially.

controls.name: Canonical Database Row Integrity Post-Conditions
controls.description: Verifies that genuine actor and row-locking SQL executed and that call group, room, and member rows remain intact in PostgreSQL.

controls.name: Strict Cleanup Settlement Verification and RED Override
controls.description: Enforces that cleanup settlement is verified; if schema, media, redis, or inspector cleanup fails, exit code 2 strictly overrides any assertion RED.

controls.name: Sanitized Evidence Reporting Without Overwrites
controls.description: Ensures that probe reports are written with flag wx without overwriting previous runs, and that errors are sanitized without stack traces, credentials, or tokens.
